values.value: How much of your email content is template and copy that can be rebuilt as-is, versus AMPscript, SSJS and Cloud Pages that have no equivalent on the target?

[{"value":1,"label":"Heavy AMPscript and SSJS throughout, plus Cloud Pages doing customer-facing work. Content is an application, not a template set."},{"value":2,"label":"AMPscript in most sends \u2014 lookups and conditional blocks \u2014 and at least one Cloud Page that matters."},{"value":3,"label":"AMPscript confined to simple attribute substitution; no SSJS; Cloud Pages absent or disposable."},{"value":4,"label":"Templates and copy only. Personalisation is merge fields, and the template count is small enough to rebuild deliberately."}]
Ask for a count of email assets containing %%[ ]%% or %%= =%%, and whether any Cloud Page is customer-facing.
